title: Let's build a Chatbot - Image/PDF Input (Part 8)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to part eight of Let's Build a Chatbot in C-Sharp using Gating Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第八部分。

cues.en: In this video, we are going to extend one more feature.
cues.zh: 這支影片會再擴充一項功能。

cues.en: Last part, we added image generation, and now we want to go the other way around, that we want to be able to actually give
cues.zh: 上一部分加入圖像生成，現在要反過來，讓我們能提供，

cues.en: our chatbot images and PDFs, just like you can chat GPT, and in order for it to analyze about what is in PDFs and images.
cues.zh: 圖片與 PDF 給聊天機器人，就像 ChatGPT 一樣，讓它分析檔案內容。

cues.en: For this version, there is a breaking change, where the existing conversations that you have already done,
cues.zh: 這個版本有一項不相容的變更。如果跟著實作，先前建立的對話，

cues.en: if you follow along, will not work anymore.
cues.zh: 將無法繼續使用。

cues.en: I will explain a little later why, but if you want to follow along, you would need to go into your temp folder and delete the existing conversations,
cues.zh: 稍後會解釋原因，但如果要跟著操作，需要到暫存資料夾，刪除既有對話，

cues.en: because I've changed the format of conversations in this way.
cues.zh: 因為我修改了對話的資料格式。

cues.en: So I'm going to do that, and then I'm going to run the system again.
cues.zh: 我先完成這件事，再次執行系統。

cues.en: And what is new here is we have a plus button in order to add what we want of PDFs and images.
cues.zh: 新的地方是這個加號按鈕，可以加入 PDF 與圖片。

cues.en: And beyond that, if we take an image, let's say, take this robot and say, what is this?
cues.zh: 例如選取這個機器人圖片，再問：這是什麼？

cues.en: We now see this small image up here of the image, but we are giving this image to the LLM, so it can actually explain what is in it.
cues.zh: 上方可以看到圖片縮圖，實際上也會把圖片提供給 LLM，讓它解釋內容。

cues.en: And in the same manner, we can choose, for example, an actual invoice,
cues.zh: 同樣地，也能選擇一份真實發票，

cues.en: and say, what did I pay in this invoice?
cues.zh: 詢問這張發票付了多少錢。

cues.en: The thing would be a PDF as input instead, and it will go in and figure out how much I paid in this case.
cues.zh: 這次輸入是 PDF，模型會分析實際支付金額。

cues.en: So that's the new features.
cues.zh: 這就是新功能。

cues.en: So why did we need to change the conversation format and stuff like that?
cues.zh: 那為什麼需要修改對話格式？

cues.en: So let's go into the code.
cues.zh: 進入程式碼看看。

cues.en: So here we are in the code, and here are the changes I've made.
cues.zh: 這裡就是程式碼，以及這次的修改。

cues.en: So I'm primarily going to use the diff in order to show you where the changes are.
cues.zh: 主要透過差異比較，顯示修改的位置。

cues.en: Because we had our models with conversation and conversation messages, and inside those messages were the raw message, the chat button message
cues.zh: 原本有 Conversation 與 ConversationMessage 模型，訊息裡保留原始 ChatMessage，

cues.en: that Agent Framework uses directly.
cues.zh: 也就是 Agent Framework 直接使用的格式。

cues.en: And that was okay right now, because we wanted to save every single little thing we sent along to the LLM.
cues.zh: 先前這樣很好，因為希望保留每個送給 LLM 的細節。

cues.en: But now that we're sending images, these JSON files down here were beginning to become rather big because they had the base 64 version of the image.
cues.zh: 但現在加入圖片，這些 JSON 檔案開始變得很大，因為其中包含圖片的 Base64。

cues.en: And I don't think that's a good way.
cues.zh: 我認為這不是好方法。

cues.en: We could have stayed that way, but in order for us to not have that, I rather wanted to make this a little more lean
cues.zh: 雖然可以維持原狀，但為了避免這件事，我想讓對話格式更精簡，

cues.en: in making it fully our own system.
cues.zh: 完全改由自己控制。

cues.en: So now we don't have the raw message, but we're simply just saving each message where we are saving content and now also attachments.
cues.zh: 因此不再保存 RawMessage，而是在每則訊息中，直接保存 Content，以及新增的附件。

cues.en: And because we can do that attachment using a relative part now, it doesn't fill up in this file.
cues.zh: 附件現在可以只保留相對路徑，不必把檔案內容塞進 JSON。

cues.en: So this is the main reason why we had a backward compatibility with these files.
cues.zh: 這就是這次無法與舊檔相容的主要原因。

cues.en: So the conversation now, instead of making a raw message to mean chat message, it just on each message itself
cues.zh: 現在對話不再把 RawMessage 直接當成 ChatMessage，而是每則訊息分別，

cues.en: store the raw role, text, and content and uses as we did before.
cues.zh: 儲存角色、文字、Content 與原本的 Usage。

cues.en: Now we have the attachments as well next to the image part.
cues.zh: 除了 ImagePart，也多了 Attachments。

cues.en: So we're just getting rid of that we were not really in control because chat message fit our system well so far,
cues.zh: 因此移除原本不完全受我們控制的部分。先前 ChatMessage 很適合需求，

cues.en: but suddenly there was something in there, meaning the base 64, that didn't fit us.
cues.zh: 但突然多了 Base64 這個不適合的內容。

cues.en: So that's the reason why I made this change and refactor.
cues.zh: 所以才進行這次變更與重構。

cues.en: So if we look at that, we then now just have the conversations.
cues.zh: 看看現在的對話物件。

cues.en: Jump over here.
cues.zh: 切換到這裡。

cues.en: And whenever we add a conversation, there might be some attachments now as well.
cues.zh: 現在加入對話訊息時，可能也會有附件。

cues.en: And those attachments are simply just a file name.
cues.zh: 附件只保存檔案資訊。

cues.en: So this is the original file name.
cues.zh: 這是原始檔名。

cues.en: The stored file name will just be a file name with a grid, the content type, if it's a PDF or images,
cues.zh: 實際儲存的檔名使用 GUID，另外保存 ContentType，判斷是 PDF 還是圖片，

cues.en: and the relative part where we store it because we are using the app data of our system.
cues.zh: 以及相對儲存路徑，因為使用系統的 AppData 資料夾。

cues.en: Let's go into chatbot and the source.
cues.zh: 進入 Chatbot 的原始碼資料夾。

cues.en: There we can see the app data here where the file uploads are.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到 AppData，裡面有 FileUploads。

cues.en: You can see I've used this robot a few times.
cues.zh: 這個機器人圖片已經使用過幾次。

cues.en: So that's what we have changed here.
cues.zh: 這就是這部分的變更。

cues.en: And in order for us then to send these messages along to the system, we of course need to have something that take a conversation,
cues.zh: 接著要把訊息提供給系統，當然需要一個轉換層，取得 Conversation，

cues.en: which is now a fully custom object, and turn it into a chat message.
cues.zh: 它現在是完全自訂的物件，再轉成 ChatMessage。

cues.en: And that's what this little service does.
cues.zh: 這就是這個小服務的工作。

cues.en: That says, given a conversation, I can give the list of chat messages that the LLM needs.
cues.zh: 給它一個 Conversation，就能回傳 LLM 需要的 ChatMessage 清單。

cues.en: So essentially we're just building up for each message of type chat message.
cues.zh: 基本上就是逐則建立 ChatMessage。

cues.en: We now, our conversation message, we build up to have a chat message.
cues.zh: 把自己的 ConversationMessage 轉成 ChatMessage。

cues.en: And we do that by on the fly building up the user messages with the text content like normal.
cues.zh: 使用者訊息像平常一樣，以 TextContent 建立。

cues.en: And for each attachment, we actually read it from file and turn it into a content.
cues.zh: 每個附件則從檔案讀取，再轉成 Content。

cues.en: An AI content down here with the data content as a base64.
cues.zh: 也就是下面的 AIContent，使用包含 Base64 的 DataContent。

cues.en: So the base64 still happens, but only up against the LLM, not inside our conversations.
cues.zh: 所以仍然會使用 Base64，但只在呼叫 LLM 時，不會存進對話。

cues.en: Because in essence, whenever we do this, it is very, very simple
cues.zh: 本質上，送出這些資料其實非常簡單，

cues.en: because we just need to give AI content to the LLM.
cues.zh: 只需要提供 AIContent 給 LLM。

cues.en: And that's the only thing we do whenever we send one of these.
cues.zh: 每次傳送時，做的就是這件事。

cues.en: So if I set a breakpoint here,
cues.zh: 如果在這裡設中斷點，

cues.en: and go into a new chat,
cues.zh: 開啟新對話，

cues.en: and let's say we send this invoice.
cues.zh: 例如上傳這份發票，

cues.en: And we send here.
cues.zh: 再按送出，

cues.en: And we want to send the conversation message. What is this?
cues.zh: 就會送出這個 ConversationMessage，問題是「這是什麼？」。

cues.en: Role user with one attachment being this attachment file.
cues.zh: 角色是 user，並包含這個附件檔案。

cues.en: We are essentially just sending the content of a text content and a data content.
cues.zh: 實際上只是傳送一個 TextContent，以及一個 DataContent。

cues.en: So I have a previous video in the Agent Framework series where I show this in a little more detail, but essentially, we're just taking the content,
cues.zh: Agent Framework 系列前面有影片，更詳細介紹過。但基本上就是取得內容，

cues.en: turning it into base64, and sending it just like we would send text.
cues.zh: 轉成 Base64，再像傳送文字一樣送出。

cues.en: In this case, it's PDF, but it could also be an image.
cues.zh: 這裡是 PDF，但也可以是圖片。

cues.en: So that's the only thing LLM-wise we needed to change.
cues.zh: 這就是 LLM 部分唯一需要的修改。

cues.en: So had I not needed to do these conversions, there would not have been too much code here.
cues.zh: 因此如果不用做那些格式轉換，其實不需要寫太多程式碼。

cues.en: But I found it to be the right time to actually get rid of the raw message in there.
cues.zh: 不過我認為，現在正適合移除原本保存的 RawMessage。

cues.en: But essentially, that's just what we're doing whenever we send things along.
cues.zh: 送出資料時，基本上做的就是這些。

cues.en: So when we get our messages here,
cues.zh: 這裡取得訊息後，

cues.en: that's the messages we're going to send along to the system when we do the streaming or the non-streaming.
cues.zh: 就是串流或非串流呼叫時，要送給系統的內容。

cues.en: So there's nothing more to it from the LLM perspective.
cues.zh: 從 LLM 角度來看，沒有更多變更。

cues.en: And it would, of course, answer back.
cues.zh: 接著當然會正常回覆。

cues.en: So what else have we changed?
cues.zh: 還修改了什麼？

cues.en: We have made our chatbot have a system to upload files, of course.
cues.zh: 當然替聊天機器人加入檔案上傳介面。

cues.en: This is just normal Blazor uploading of files, nothing special in there.
cues.zh: 這只是一般 Blazor 檔案上傳，沒有特別之處。

cues.en: Just a normal file upload input file here.
cues.zh: 使用普通的 InputFile 元件。

cues.en: So when we do that, and we send the message, of course, we need various things for uploading the storage and changing it into the new mapper.
cues.zh: 選好檔案並送出時，需要處理儲存，以及轉成新的映射格式。

cues.en: There's a little thing about how big the files can be at maximum.
cues.zh: 也有最大檔案大小設定。

cues.en: And pending files should, of course, be there while we choose one or more files.
cues.zh: 選擇一個或多個檔案時，會保存在 PendingFiles。

cues.en: We then check if we just send a file, not just input.
cues.zh: 接著檢查，是否只送檔案，而沒有文字。

cues.en: So now it can't go that we not even send a file or a message,
cues.zh: 不能連檔案與訊息都沒有就送出，

cues.en: but we can actually just send a file, and it will begin to interpret from that.
cues.zh: 但可以只送檔案，讓它直接分析。

cues.en: In here, we just make the attachments, and we are saving them as files.
cues.zh: 這裡建立附件，並儲存成檔案。

cues.en: And that is just normal files to a place we save.
cues.zh: 就是一般檔案寫入指定位置。

cues.en: And in that place we save right now is our AppData folder, as I showed before.
cues.zh: 目前儲存在剛剛看到的 AppData 資料夾。

cues.en: So this is just normal Blazor writing files down to a folder.
cues.zh: 因此只是 Blazor 把檔案寫到資料夾。

cues.en: And returning a conversation attachment.
cues.zh: 最後回傳 ConversationAttachment。

cues.en: So nothing special there.
cues.zh: 沒有什麼特別之處。

cues.en: We, of course, reset things on the fly, and we have our pending attachment.
cues.zh: 當然也會即時重設狀態，清空待處理附件。

cues.en: So nothing major there.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有重大改動。

cues.en: And again, whenever we send, we just get our new chat messages instead of the raw messages prior.
cues.zh: 同樣地，每次送出時，現在取得轉換後的 ChatMessage，而不是直接使用先前的原始訊息。

cues.en: Inside the image generation tool, we just need to generate a conversation message instead of one with a raw message, so that's the only change there.
cues.zh: 圖像生成工具中，也只要改成建立 ConversationMessage，而不是包含 RawMessage 的版本。

cues.en: There's a bit of CSS. We won't go too much into detail of that.
cues.zh: 有一些 CSS 變更，這裡不詳細介紹。

cues.en: And we, of course, need to set our new singletons for our services,
cues.zh: 也需要把新服務註冊為單例，

cues.en: and we need to use static files in order for us to work with these files.
cues.zh: 並使用靜態檔案功能，才能提供這些檔案。

cues.en: And because we want to see the images on the screen, we also need a small map get in order for the GUI up front
cues.zh: 因為要在畫面顯示圖片，還加入一個簡單的 MapGet，讓前端介面，

cues.en: to actually show the images on the fly as a service in here.
cues.zh: 可以透過這個端點取得並顯示圖片。

cues.en: So that's actually everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 完整內容就是這些。

cues.en: Again, it could have been much simpler because we just put in the content.
cues.zh: 再次強調，核心可以更簡單，因為只是加入 Content。

cues.en: And if you want to see more, let me open that up because I do run all these other samples.
cues.zh: 如果想看更多，我打開另一個範例，因為這些範例都有維護。

cues.en: So let me open up another Visual Studio.
cues.zh: 再開啟一個 Visual Studio。

cues.en: Just if you want to be more familiar with the input.
cues.zh: 如果想更熟悉輸入資料的做法，

cues.en: I have in my samples the input PDF and image, where you can see that I have some images of some board game,
cues.zh: 範例裡有 Input PDF and Image，包含一些桌遊圖片，

cues.en: and this exact same code where we end up creating either local page images and making them into text content.
cues.zh: 以及完全相同的程式碼，讀取本機圖片並建立對應的輸入 Content。

cues.en: We could also have made the images, make them be a URL, and then given the URL to the LLM,
cues.zh: 也可以把圖片放在 URL，再把 URL 提供給 LLM，

cues.en: but that is not possible here because we are running local host, of course.
cues.zh: 但這裡無法使用，因為在 localhost 執行。

cues.en: But I have more information, if need be, in that sample.
cues.zh: 如果需要，該範例有更多資訊。

cues.en: But that's actually everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就是這樣。

cues.en: It's a very simple part.
cues.zh: 核心是很簡單的一部分。

cues.en: There is a few limitations in what I built here.
cues.zh: 不過目前實作仍有幾項限制。

cues.en: So, for example, we haven't really built that the image generator together with the image recognizer can do things.
cues.zh: 例如還沒有把圖像生成與圖像理解功能串接起來。

cues.en: So it's not like we can do the same as what they can do in ChatGPT that you can upload an image and say, now turn the background green, for example,
cues.zh: 所以不像 ChatGPT，可以上傳圖片，再要求把背景改成綠色，

cues.en: or something like that. That doesn't really work here because we don't really have a concept of sending the existing image
cues.zh: 或類似操作。這裡還不行，因為沒有把現有圖片，

cues.en: and actually doing image editing instead of image generation.
cues.zh: 傳給圖像編輯，而不是圖像生成的機制。

cues.en: But that could be done, but I have chosen not to put this in right now.
cues.zh: 當然做得到，只是目前選擇先不加入。

cues.en: We might do it at a fit-and-finish session at some point.
cues.zh: 也許之後會在完善功能的單元處理。

cues.en: But that's everything there is for this today.
cues.zh: 今天的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
